tenderSchedule.title: GIS based Pre-Feasibility Report for the Identification of Unsurveyed Land in coast of Karnataka in compliance with Indian Ports Act.
tenderSchedule.description: Appointment of a Consulting Agency for the Preparation of a GIS based Pre-Feasibility Report for the Identification of Unsurveyed Land in coast of Karnataka in compliance with Indian Ports Act. The Bidder shall be responsible for the GIS-Based High-Precision Drone Survey for Mapping, Identification of Unsurveyed & Unutilized Land Parcels, Checkbandi Preparation, and Port Land Encroachments across Karnataka Coastline & Port Limits.
tenderSchedule.deptName: Infrastructure Development Ports And Inland Water Transport Department

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Call contact person for VC(Video Conference) link. Port Engineer Section, Office of the Director, Ports and Member, Maritime and Inland Water Navigation Operations, KMB Karwar

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance of the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of the e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at the bidders end
The bidder must comply with all the terms and conditions as laid out in the RFP. Conditional Tenders are not allowed.
Tender inviting authority reserves the rights to reject or accept any one or all tenders at any stage of the tender, which will be binding on all bidders

Applicants must carefully read the minimum conditions of eligibility (the Conditions of Eligibility) provided herein. Proposals of only those Applicants who satisfy the Conditions of Eligibility will be considered for evaluation

While submitting a Proposal, the Applicant should attach clearly marked and referenced continuation sheets in the event that the space provided in the specified forms in the Appendices is insufficient. Alternatively, Applicants may format the specified forms, making due provision for incorporation of the requested information
Bidder should quote their rate Exclusive of GST, but inclusive of all other taxes, duties, levies, Overheads and Contingencies

In strict compliance with DGFT Notifications and the Drone Rules, 2021, and any subsequent ammendments, the agency shall deploy only DGCA/QCI Type-Certified UAVs indigenously manufactured or legally assembled in India. Deployment of foreign-built, imported complete drones (in CBU/SKD/CKD forms) or uncertified hardware is strictly prohibited. All deployed drones must hold a valid Unique Identification Number (UIN) registered on the DGCA portal.
